contentText:
John Reynolds / Tech.eu :

London-based Boltz, which is developing AI models to speed up drug discovery, raised a $110M Series A led by Bessemer, after raising a $28M seed in 2025   —  Boltz was spun out of MIT but is now located in London.  —  London-based AI drug discovery startup Boltz has raised a $110m Series A funding round …
